title: UniVVT: A Unified End-to-End Framework for High-Fidelity Video Virtual Try-on
abstract: arXiv:2608.05745v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video Virtual Try-On (VVT) synthesizes a video of a person wearing a target garment while preserving identity, motion, and scene dynamics. Dominant approaches cast VVT as mask-conditioned video inpainting and rely on separate modules for human parsing, pose estimation, and garment warping. This multi-stage design complicates deployment and, more critically, allows errors in explicit geometric priors to propagate irreversibly into the generated video. We present UniVVT, a unified end-to-end framework that reframes VVT as semantically conditioned video generation, eliminating mask, pose, and warping modules at inference. At its core, a scene-task perceiver built on a Multimodal Large Language Model jointly encodes the source video, target garment, and task instruction into compact, task-aware latent tokens, implicitly capturing what to transfer and where and how to transfer it. translated_title: UniVVT：一种用于高保真视频虚拟试穿的统一端到端框架
translated_abstract: 视频虚拟试穿（VVT）合成一个人穿着目标服装的视频，同时保持身份、运动和场景动态。主流方法将VVT视为掩码条件下的视频修复，并依赖单独模块进行人体解析、姿态估计和服装变形。这种多阶段设计使部署复杂化，更关键的是，允许显式几何先验中的错误不可逆地传播到生成的视频中。我们提出UniVVT，一种统一的端到端框架，将VVT重新定义为语义条件下的视频生成，在推理时消除了掩码、姿态和变形模块。其核心是一个基于多模态大语言模型的场景任务感知器，联合编码源视频、目标服装和任务指令为紧凑的、任务感知的潜在令牌，隐式捕获要转移的内容以及转移的位置和方式。一个轻量级语义桥接器随后将这些令牌对齐以生成高保真视频。
tldr: UniVVT通过统一端到端框架和基于多模态大语言模型的场景任务感知器，消除了掩码、姿态和变形模块，实现了高保真视频虚拟试穿。
en_tdlr: UniVVT achieves high-fidelity video virtual try-on by unifying the process with an end-to-end framework and a multimodal LLM-based scene-task perceiver, eliminating mask, pose, and warping modules.
